title.en: Trump to meet with US negotiators to decide on Iran’s ceasefire proposal
title.zh: 特朗普将会见美国谈判代表，决定伊朗的停火提议

summary.en: US President Donald Trump is scheduled to meet with American negotiators to review Iran’s latest ceasefire proposal. He stated the decision to either make a deal or launch a military strike is "a solid 50/50."
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将与美国谈判代表会面，审查伊朗最新的停火提议。他表示，达成协议或发动军事打击的决定是“五五开”。

body.en: US president says it’s a ‘solid 50/50’ on either making a ‘good’ deal with Iran or striking the country anew Donald Trump said he would meet today with American negotiators to review Iran’s latest proposal and decide by Sunday whether he will strike Iran “to kingdom come”. Trump told Axios it was a “solid 50/50” on whether he would be able to make a “good” deal with Iran or begin striking the country anew. He will be meeting with special envoy Steve Witkoff and adviser Jared Kushner, along with JD Vance . Continue reading...

title.en: Red Cross volunteers die from suspected Ebola in DR Congo
title.zh: 红十字会志愿者在刚果民主共和国死于疑似埃博拉病毒

summary.en: Red Cross volunteers are believed to have died from suspected Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, having likely contracted the virus before the outbreak was officially identified, according to the organization.
summary.zh: 红十字会表示，在刚果民主共和国，红十字会志愿者被认为死于疑似埃博拉病毒，他们可能在疫情被正式确认之前就已感染该病毒。

body.en:
Three Red Cross volunteers died in the Democratic Republic of Congo from suspected Ebola likely caught while managing dead bodies, the organisation has said.

They are believed to have contracted Ebola on 27 March while working in the eastern region of Ituri on a project unrelated to the virus, before the outbreak was identified.

The volunteers are thought to be among the first to die in DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, which has resulted in more than 170 suspected deaths and 750 suspected cases.

The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) said they had died after serving their communities "with courage and humanity".

The outbreak "had not been identified" when Alikana Udumusi Augustin, Sezabo Katanabo and Ajiko Chandiru Viviane were working with the dead bodies, the IFRC said.

They died between 5 and 16 May and had been working in the town of Mongbwalu, which is now considered the epicentre of the outbreak.

On Friday, the World Health Organization (WHO) raised the public health risk from the virus in DR Congo from "high" to "very high".

WHO chief Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus also said the risk in the wider region in Africa was "high" but remained "low" globally.

The outbreak involves a rare species of Ebola, known as Bundibugyo, which has no proven vaccine and kills about a third of those infected.

Health experts warn that touching the body of someone who died from Ebola can spread the virus because bodily fluids remain highly infectious after death.

DR Congo's neighbour, Uganda, has also reported cases of the virus. On Saturday, its health ministry confirmed three new cases - bringing the number of confirmed infections there to five.

The same day, the African Centres for Disease Control warned 10 other countries on the continent were at risk of being affected: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia.

In DR Congo, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) said a tent it had provided in Mongbwalu to treat Ebola patients was burnt on Friday.

"Understandably, there are still many uncertainties and fears among the community in this rapidly evolving context," it said.

"This incident highlights just how critical sustained community engagement and trust building are."

The previous day, an angry crowd elsewhere in Ituri set alight part of a hospital after the family and friends of a young man thought to have died from Ebola were prevented from taking his body away for burial.

Along with Ituri, cases have been detected in the North and South Kivu regions. Parts of the two eastern areas are under the control of the M23, a rebel group that controls parts of the region - which has brought additional difficulties in dealing with Ebola.
body.zh: 该组织表示，三名红十字志愿者在刚果民主共和国死于疑似埃博拉病毒，可能是在处理尸体时感染的。 据信，他们于 3 月 27 日在伊图里东部地区从事与该病毒无关的项目时感染了埃博拉病毒，当时疫情尚未确定。 这些志愿者被认为是刚果民主共和国埃博拉疫情中最先死亡的人之一，该疫情已导致 170 多人疑似死亡和 750 例疑似病例。 红十字会与红新月会国际联合会（IFRC）表示，他们“以勇气和人道”为社区服务后去世。 红十字与红新月联会表示，当 Alikana Udumusi Augustin、Sezabo Katanabo 和 Ajiko Chandiru Viviane 处理尸体时，疫情“尚未确定”。 他们于 5 月 5 日至 16 日期间死亡，当时他们一直在 Mongbwalu 镇工作，该镇现在被认为是疫情爆发的中心。 周五，世界卫生组织（WHO）将刚果民主共和国的病毒公共卫生风险从“高”提高到“非常高”。 世卫组织总干事谭德塞博士还表示，非洲更广泛地区的风险“较高”，但全球范围内仍处于“低”水平。 这次疫情涉及一种罕见的埃博拉病毒，称为本迪布焦（Bundibugyo），这种病毒没有经过验证的疫苗，并导致约三分之一的感染者死亡。 健康专家警告说，接触埃博拉死亡者的尸体可能会传播病毒，因为死后体液仍然具有高度传染性。 刚果民主共和国的邻国乌干达也报告了该病毒病例。周六，其卫生部确认了三例新病例，使确诊感染人数达到五例。 同一天，非洲疾病控制中心警告非洲大陆其他10个国家也面临受到影响的风险：安哥拉、布隆迪、中非共和国、刚果共和国、埃塞俄比亚、肯尼亚、卢旺达、南苏丹、坦桑尼亚和赞比亚。 在刚果民主共和国，无国界医生组织（MSF）表示，其在蒙布瓦卢提供的用于治疗埃博拉患者的帐篷于周五被烧毁。 报告称：“可以理解的是，在这个快速发展的背景下，社区中仍然存在许多不确定性和恐惧。” “这一事件凸显了持续的社区参与和信任建设的重要性。” 前一天，一名被认为死于埃博拉的年轻人的家人和朋友被阻止将他的尸体运走埋葬，伊图里其他地方的一群愤怒的人群点燃了一家医院的一部分。 与伊图里一起，北基伍和南基伍地区也发现了病例。这两个东部地区的部分地区处于“M23”叛乱组织的控制之下，该组织控制着该地区的部分地区，这给应对埃博拉病毒带来了额外的困难。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of these Red Cross volunteers reminds us of the profound sacrifice made by those who serve the sick and vulnerable in dangerous conditions. Jesus taught that when we care for 'the least of these,' we are caring for Him directly. Their selfless act of compassion, even unto death, embodies a deep commitment to humanity.
reflection.zh: 这些红十字会志愿者的不幸牺牲，提醒我们那些在危险环境中服务病患和弱势群体的人所做出的巨大牺牲。耶稣教导我们，当我们关怀“这些最小的弟兄”时，我们就是直接关怀他。他们这种甚至以生命为代价的无私怜悯行为，体现了对人类的深切承诺。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: US, Iran strike upbeat tone as Hormuz deal takes shape
title.zh: 霍尔木兹协议成形，美国和伊朗表达乐观态度

summary.en: US President Donald Trump flagged progress in talks with Iran, Tehran has warned that major gaps still stand in the way of dialing down the conflict.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump flagged progress in talks with Iran, Tehran has warned that major gaps still stand in the way of dialing down the conflict.

The United States and Iran  signaled progress on Saturday toward a framework agreement that could end a nearly three-month standoff triggered by US and Israeli attacks on Iran and the shutdown of the Strait of Hormuz .

The step forward comes as global pressure grows to avert a wider regional conflict, with mediators saying both sides are inching closer to a workable de-escalation plan.

US President  Donald Trump told CBS News that the two sides were "getting a lot closer" to finalizing a deal.

He refused to give specifics about the plan, but said that "every day it gets better and better."

In a separate interview with US news outlet Axios, Trump said the chance of an agreement was a "solid 50/50," while threatening to "blow them to kingdom come" if talks fail. 

Earlier in the day, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke of " slight progress" in negotiations, adding that "there might be some news a little later today," although it may come on Sunday or within "a couple of days."

Speaking during a visit to India, Rubio also refused to rule out a resumption of US attacks on Iran if negotiations fail.

Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei, meanwhile, told state broadcaster IRIB that Tehran was in the final stages of drafting a framework for a deal, but said a final accord would take more time.

"Within a reasonable period of 30 to 60 days, the details of these points will be discussed and a final agreement will ultimately be concluded," Baqaei told IRIB.

He added that major gaps remain between both sides and that an end to the US blockade of Hormuz be part of the framework. The blockade has halted Iran's oil exports, the main source of income for the Islamic Republic.

While Rubio restated US demands that Tehran hand over highly enriched uranium linked to Iran's controversial nuclear program, Baqaei insisted nuclear talks would not be part of the initial deal.

Also on Saturday, the Financial Times cited mediators as saying both sides were close to a deal on extending the ceasefire, which began on April 8, for 60 days. That deal would include a gradual reopening of Hormuz, the report said.

The renewed optimism from both sides came hours after Pakistan's powerful army chief, Field Marshal Asim Munir, held talks with Iranian leaders in Tehran.

A statement from the Pakistani army later said his meetings had been highly productive.

title.en: In Iran, internet access becomes a luxury for the few
title.zh: 在伊朗，互联网接入成为少数人的奢侈品

summary.en: Despite the ongoing internet blockade in Iran, access to "Internet-Pro" is available to select groups for a fee. Access to information and communication is increasingly becoming a luxury.
summary.zh: 尽管伊朗持续进行互联网封锁，但少数特定群体可以付费使用“专业互联网”。信息和通讯的获取正日益成为一种奢侈品。

body.en:
Despite the ongoing internet blockade in Iran, access to "Internet-Pro" is available to select groups for a fee. Access to information and communication is increasingly becoming a luxury.

Iran's National Security Council recently approved a plan to grant certain groups paid internet access, albeit with a daily usage limit on foreign websites and international data traffic.

The internet in Iran has been shut down since the United States and Israel launched attacks on the country on February 28.

"Internet Pro" does not refer to a technical upgrade, but allows users standard internet access that bypasses the block.

According to journalist and internet researcher Solmaz Eikder, major platforms such as Instagram, X and YouTube — which have long been blocked in Iran — still cannot be used even by many "Internet Pro" users without a virtual private network (VPN).

Eikder has been living in exile in Europe for five years. She works for Filterbaan, also known as Filterwatch, an Iranian digital rights organization that monitors  internet censorship , digital repression and surveillance in Iran. The findings are frequently used by journalists, activists and researchers who study digital repression in Iran.

The current shutdown, which has now lasted for more than 80 days, is the  longest yet in Iran , but not the first of its kind.

For years, the Iranian security apparatus has used this method to disrupt communication between Iranians and to cut off the outside world. This most recently occurred during nationwide protests in January , which the regime brutally suppressed.

Millions of people are now once again cut off from the digital economy and communication.

According to government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani, "Internet Pro" is intended to "prevent disruptions to economic activity and ensure business communication in times of crisis."

The service is offered to certain professional groups, such as members of the Chamber of Commerce, startups, technology companies and retailers. They receive an initial package of 50 gigabytes of data, which costs the equivalent of about $11 (around €9.50).

"That's a lot of money in Iran," said Eikder. Since the war began, many households have been under growing economic pressure. Inflation has risen to over 50% and the value of the rial has plunged, leading to a sharp increase in prices for basic necessities.

Destroyed industrial facilities and massive production losses have hit the economy hard. Tens of thousands of jobs have been lost.

Furthermore, millions of smaller income sources have been wiped out by internet blocks .

title.en: New breed of political prisoner arises in Britain as anti-protest sentences rise
title.zh: 英国反抗议判决增加，新型政治犯出现

summary.en: Research indicates that more individuals are being jailed in England and Wales for actions aimed at preventing climate breakdown and protesting the war in Gaza. This trend has led to the emergence of a new category of political prisoners in Britain.
summary.zh: 研究显示，在英格兰和威尔士，因采取行动阻止气候崩溃和抗议加沙战争而被监禁的人数正在增加。这导致英国出现了一种新型的政治犯。

body.en: More people are being jailed in England and Wales as a result of acting to prevent climate breakdown and the war in Gaza, research reveals Britain has created a new breed of political prisoners through the systematic incarceration of people acting to prevent climate breakdown and the annihilation of Gaza, a report claims. The research by Queen Mary University of London (QMUL) and the protest group Defend Our Juries says that custodial sentences for acts of direct action or civil disobedience were once rare but are now being imposed with increasing length and frequency. body.zh: 一份报告称，英格兰和威尔士有越来越多的人因采取行动阻止气候崩溃和加沙战争而被监禁，研究显示，英国通过系统性监禁采取行动阻止气候崩溃和加沙战争的人，创造了新型政治犯。伦敦玛丽女王大学 (QMUL) 和抗议组织“捍卫我们的陪审团”的研究表明，对直接行动或公民不服从行为判处监禁的情况曾经很少见，但现在判处的时间和频率都在增加。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights individuals facing imprisonment for actions driven by deep convictions regarding climate and conflict. This echoes the ancient tension between human laws and a perceived higher moral calling. For those who believe they must obey God rather than human beings, such moments test the conscience and commitment to justice.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了个人因对气候和冲突的深刻信念而采取行动，面临监禁。这反映了人类法律与更高道德召唤之间由来已久的张力。对于那些相信必须顺从雅伟而非顺从人的人来说，这样的时刻考验着良知和对公义的委身。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

The explosion happened on Friday at 7.29pm (12.29 BST) while 247 workers were underground at the Liushenyu coalmine in Qinyuan county, the state media agency Xinhua reported. Continue reading...

This promise offers solace, pointing to an ultimate restoration...

reflection.zh: 公职要求在看似微小的事务上也要保持诚信，例如市政税。这个情况提醒我们，忠实履行细微的责任，往往反映了一个人更广泛的可靠性以及对道德行为的承诺。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.

title.en: F1 great Prost 'injured as masked gang raid home'
title.zh: F1伟大的普罗斯特“因蒙面团伙袭击回家而受伤”

summary.en: Four-time Formula 1 world champion Alain Prost was injured when a masked gang raided his home near Geneva, Swiss media reports.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Formula 1 great Alain Prost suffered a head injury when a masked gang raided his home, Swiss media reports claim.

The violent robbery took place at the home of the French four-time world champion in Nyon, about 25km north of Geneva, according to Blick. , external

Police have confirmed a family was targeted by robbers at around 8:30am on Tuesday, but have not released the victims' identities.

"Several masked individuals entered the house. Once inside, they threatened the occupants and slightly injured one family member in the head, under circumstances that are still being investigated," a statement from the Vaud cantonal police force said.

"The perpetrators then forced another family member to open a safe before fleeing," it added.

A "large-scale search operation" was launched involving both Swiss and French police and border security, while a psychological support team has been provided to the family, police added..

Prost, 71, drove for McLaren, Renault, Ferrari and Williams in a 13-year F1 career, winning the world title in 1985, 1986, 1989 and 1993.

Only Michael Schumacher, Lewis Hamilton, with seven titles each, and Juan Manuel Fangio, with five, have won more championships than Prost.
body.zh: 据瑞士媒体报道，一级方程式赛车巨星阿兰·普罗斯特的家被蒙面团伙袭击，导致他头部受伤。 据布利克称，这起暴力抢劫案发生在法国四届世界冠军位于尼永的家中，尼永位于日内瓦以北约 25 公里处。 , 外部 警方证实，周二上午 8 点 30 分左右，一个家庭遭到劫匪袭击，但尚未公布受害者的身份。 沃州警方的一份声明称：“几名蒙面人进入了房子。进入后，他们威胁了居住者，并对一名家庭成员的头部造成了轻伤，具体情况仍在调查中。” “肇事者随后强迫另一名家庭成员打开保险箱，然后逃跑，”它补充道。 警方补充说，瑞士和法国警方以及边境安全部门展开了“大规模搜查行动”，同时还向该家庭提供了心理支持小组。 现年 71 岁的普罗斯特在 13 年的 F1 职业生涯中曾效力于迈凯伦、雷诺、法拉利和威廉姆斯，并于 1985 年、1986 年、1989 年和 1993 年赢得世界冠军。 只有迈克尔·舒马赫、刘易斯·汉密尔顿（分别获得 7 个冠军）和胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥（获得 5 个冠军）比普罗斯特赢得的冠军更多。

title.en: Thousands evacuated in California over warning toxic chemical tank could explode or spill
title.zh: 有毒化学品泄漏迫使洛杉矶附近数千人疏散

summary.en: Thousands of residents near Los Angeles have been forced to evacuate due to a toxic chemical leak from a tank in Orange County. Officials have warned that the substance is highly volatile and could lead to an explosion.
summary.zh: 洛杉矶附近数千居民因奥兰治县一个储罐的有毒化学品泄漏而被迫疏散。官员警告称，该物质高度不稳定，可能导致爆炸。

body.en:
More than 40,000 people have been ordered to leave their homes in Orange County in southern California, after a toxic chemical leak at a manufacturing facility.

The pressurised tank contains about 7,000 gallons of methyl methacrylate, a highly volatile and flammable substance used to make plastic.

"There are literally two options left," Orange County Fire Authority division chief Craig Covey said on Friday: "The tank fails and spills... or, two, the tank goes into a thermal runaway and blows up."

The aerospace facility in the town of Garden Grove is about 5 miles (8km) from Disneyland, which is outside the evacuation zone and open as normal, and about 35 miles southeast of Los Angeles.

Local schools have closed as a precaution and the exits of several major roads have shut to limit access to the area.

Orange County health officer Regina Chinsio Kwong said anyone who noticed "a fruity and heavy smell" should alert authorities.

"Smelling it doesn't mean you've reached a level that causes symptoms. But we don't want you to smell that," she said.

The evacuation zone has been expanded as fire crews worked through the night to lower the temperature of the chemical tank.

On Friday evening, officials said they had cooled the tank to about 16C (61F) and aimed to bring it down to 11C (51F). It's one of three such tanks at the facility.

Fire chief Covey told a news conference on Friday afternoon that if the tank spills, "very bad chemicals" would leak into the parking area surrounding the facility.

"Or two, the tank goes into a thermal runaway and blows up, affecting the tanks that are around it that have fuel or chemicals in them as well."

"This is not precautionary," he said. "This thing is going to fail, and we don't know when... We're doing our best to figure out when or how we can prevent it."

A hazmat team has been working with experts to find a way to depressurise the affected tank and limit exposure.

OCFA earlier said a cooling operation had been successful and crews had made progress towards safely draining the tank, but that an "inoperable valve" had created "additional operational challenges".

"I was woken up by the sirens going across our streets," Mark Olsen, who was evacuated to the Garden Grove Sports and Recreation Center, told NBC LA on Friday.

"Then I was told that they were evacuating, so I grabbed some stuff and got out of there," Olsen said.

But not knowing what would happen to the chemical plant, or when he could return home, was weighing on him.

The facility is operated by GKN Aerospace, a UK-based company that supplies parts for aircraft.

A spokesperson for the company apologised to local residents and said: "The situation remains ongoing and we are fully focused on working with emergency services, specialized...

reflection.en: When unexpected dangers like a chemical leak force thousands from their homes, it reminds us of life's fragility and the sudden need for safety. title.en: India's parody 'cockroach party' claims website has been blocked
title.zh: 印度模仿“蟑螂党”声称网站已被封锁

summary.en: The satirical group has gained millions of followers as "the voice of the lazy and unemployed".
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
India's viral "cockroach" political parody group says its website has been blocked just days after it launched.

The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has gained more than 20 million online followers since being set up as a joke after India's chief justice reportedly compared unemployed young people to the insects.

He later clarified he was referring to people with "fake and bogus degrees", not India's youth more broadly.

Its website can no longer be accessed in the country and also appears to be down elsewhere. The group's founder Abhijeet Dipke said Indian officials had "taken down our iconic website" and asked why they were "so scared of cockroaches".

He wrote on X that the group, which is not an official political party, was already working on a new "home" and added: "Cockroaches never die."

Its official X page - with more than 200,000 followers - is also inaccessible in the country. Those trying to open it are shown a message that it has been withheld "in response to a legal demand".

Dipke, a political communications strategist and student at Boston University in the US, has also claimed both his personal Instagram and the group's have been hacked.

The CJP - or the cockroach people's party - satirises the name of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), which has been in power since 2014.

The group claims to be "the voice of the lazy and unemployed". Its tongue-in-cheek membership criteria include being chronically online and having "the ability to rant professionally".

It has used AI-generated images to promote its cause online and has inspired the hashtag #MainBhiCockroach ("I too am a cockroach").

The group's Instagram account has amassed more than 22 million followers - more than twice as many as the BJP's.

Young volunteers have also turned up dressed as cockroaches at clean-up drives and protests in recent days.

Dipke previously told the BBC that the group's popularity spoke to wide discontent among young Indians about the high unemployment rate, and a feeling they are being ignored by mainstream politics.

India has one of the world's youngest populations, with roughly half its 1.4 billion people under 30 years. Yet formal political participation remains limited.
body.zh: 印度病毒式“蟑螂”政治模仿组织表示，其网站在推出几天后就被封锁。 据报道，印度首席大法官将失业年轻人比作昆虫后，蟑螂简塔党 (CJP) 被当作一个笑话，自此以来，该党已在网上获得了超过 2000 万粉丝。 他后来澄清说，他指的是拥有“假学位”的人，而不是更广泛的印度年轻人。 其网站在该国无法再访问，并且在其他地方似乎也已关闭。该组织创始人阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke) 表示，印度官员“撤下了我们标志性的网站”，并质问他们为何“如此害怕蟑螂”。 他在 X 上写道，该组织虽然不是官方政党，但已经在建造一个新的“家”，并补充道：“蟑螂永远不会死。” 它的官方 X 页面——拥有超过 200,000 名关注者——在该国也无法访问。那些试图打开它的人会看到一条消息，表明它已“根据法律要求”被扣留。 迪普克是一名政治传播策略师，也是美国波士顿大学的学生，他也声称他的个人 Instagram 和该群组的 Instagram 都遭到了黑客攻击。 CJP（即蟑螂人民党）讽刺了自 2014 年以来一直执政的印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪领导的印度人民党 (BJP)。 该组织声称自己是“懒惰者和失业者的声音”。其半开玩笑的会员标准包括长期在线和具有“专业地咆哮的能力”。 它使用人工智能生成的图像在网上宣传其事业，并激发了主题标签#MainBhiCockroach（“我也是一只蟑螂”）。 该组织的 Instagram 账户已拥有超过 2200 万粉丝，是印度人民党的两倍多。 最近几天，年轻志愿者也打扮成蟑螂出现在清理活动和抗议活动中。 迪普克此前告诉英国广播公司，该组织的受欢迎程度反映出印度年轻人对高失业率的广泛不满，以及他们被主流政治忽视的感觉。 印度是世界上人口最年轻的国家之一，其 14 亿人口中约有一半年龄在 30 岁以下。然而，正式的政治参与仍然有限。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to truth, discernment, and honest speech. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with discernment and truthful speech, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到真理、分辨与诚实。Philippians 4:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以分辨与诚实表达来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: At least 82 killed in Chinese coal mine explosion
title.zh: 中国官方媒体报道，中国煤矿爆炸至少造成90人死亡

summary.en: An explosion occurred at a coal mine in northern China on Friday evening, resulting in the deaths of at least 90 people, according to state media reports.
summary.zh: 据中国官方媒体报道，周五晚间中国北方一煤矿发生爆炸，造成至少90人死亡。

body.en:
At least 82 people have been killed and two are missing after a coal mine blast in northern China, officials have said.

Rescue officials revised down the death toll in an update late on Saturday, having earlier said at least 90 people had died.

The gas explosion at the Liushenyu Coal Mine in Shanxi province is the worst mining disaster in China since 2009.

There were 247 workers reportedly on duty when the blast happened at 19:29 local time (11:29 GMT) on Friday, with more than 100 people said to be saved and hundreds of rescuers sent to the site.

Chinese President Xi Jinping said no effort must be spared in efforts to treat the injured and search for survivors.

The country's state council later said a "rigorous" investigation would be conducted and those found responsible would be "severely punished".

Officials apologised for the confusion over the death toll, saying the situation was chaotic at the beginning which led to an unclear headcount and an incorrect figure.

They said that 128 people were being treated in hospitals, including two in critical condition.

Most were affected after inhaling poisonous gas, according to state media, though it is not clear what type of gas it was.

Wang Yong, an injured miner, told state media that when the incident happened, he did not hear a sound but saw a sudden plume of smoke.

"I smelled sulphur, the same smell you get from blasting. I shouted at people to run. As we were running I could see people collapsing from the fumes. Then I blacked out too," he said.

"I lay there for about an hour or so before I came round on my own. I woke up the person next to me and we got out together."

Some of the management team at the mine have reportedly been detained. The cause of the gas explosion has not yet been revealed, but state media reported that the levels of carbon monoxide - a highly toxic, odourless gas - in the mine were found to have "exceeded limits".

China's Ministry of Emergency Management has sent 345 personnel from six rescue teams to help with the operation.

State media said the rescue operation had encountered difficulties as water has built up near the explosion site, preventing access to certain areas, while blueprints provided by the mine did not match the actual conditions.

In 2024, the Liushenyu mine was listed as one of the "severe safety hazards" by the Chinese National Mine Safety Administration.

Tongzhou Group, which runs the mine, has reportedly received two administrative penalties in 2025 for safety issues.

This disaster is a reminder of the darkest days of China's coal mining industry.

In the early 2000s, deadly accidents were common in coal mines across the country. Safety standards have been tightened in recent years, and there has also been a crackdown on illegal coal...
body.zh: 据中国官方媒体报道，中国北方的煤矿爆炸已造成至少 90 人死亡。 瓦斯爆炸发生在山西省通州集团旗下的六神峪煤矿。 数百名救援人员已被派往现场。官方媒体的视频显示，医护人员在现场抬着担架，背景是救护车。据称已有100多人被送往医院，现场救援工作仍在进行中。 爆炸发生在当地时间周五 19 点 29 分（格林威治标准时间 11 点 29 分），山西一煤矿发生爆炸，据报道事发时有 247 名工人在值班。 事件发生后，中国国家主席习近平要求全力救治伤员、搜寻幸存者。 他还要求政府调查事故原因，追究相关责任人的责任。 据官方媒体报道，该煤矿的管理官员已被拘留。瓦斯爆炸的原因尚未公布，但官方媒体报道称，矿井中一氧化碳（一种剧毒、无味的气体）的含量被发现“超出了限度”。 中国应急管理部已派出6支救援队、345名人员协助救援。 山西是中国较贫困的省份之一，被称为中国的煤矿之都。 2000年代初期，中国煤矿行业死亡事故屡见不鲜。近年来，安全标准不断加强，但事故仍时有发生。 2023年，内蒙古北部地区一座露天煤矿发生塌方，造成53人死亡。 早在2009年，东北部黑龙江省的一座矿井发生爆炸，造成100多人死亡。 中国是世界上最大的煤炭消费国和最大的温室气体排放国，尽管它以创纪录的速度安装可再生能源。

reflection.en: The news of so many lives lost in this mine explosion brings profound sorrow and reminds us of the fragility of life. In moments of such deep grief, we hold onto the promise that one day, God will wipe away every tear, and there will be no more death or pain. This hope sustains us even as we mourn with those who suffer.
reflection.zh: 这起煤矿爆炸事故造成如此多生命逝去的消息，带来了深切的悲痛，也提醒我们生命的脆弱。在如此深重的悲伤时刻，我们紧紧抓住那应许：有一天，雅伟将擦去所有的眼泪，不再有死亡和痛苦。这份盼望在悲伤中支撑着我们，与受苦之人一同哀悼。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Thailand revives bill to clear the air of toxic smog
title.zh: 泰国重启法案以清除有毒雾霾

summary.en: Thailand is reviving a long-delayed bill to combat seasonal toxic smog, a significant public health issue. The legislation aims to prevent air pollution, but its effective enforcement remains a concern.
summary.zh: 泰国正在重启一项长期搁置的法案，以应对季节性有毒雾霾这一严重的公共卫生问题。该立法旨在从源头上阻止空气污染，但其有效执行仍是人们关注的焦点。

body.en:
Seasonal smog is a major public health problem in Thailand. Long-delayed legislation aims to stop air pollution before it starts, but enforcement could present a problem.

Thailand's parliament has revived  long-delayed legislation to recognize clean air as a protected public right, a major step in a country where seasonal smog has become an annual health emergency.

Last week, lawmakers voted 611-3 to advance the Clean Air Act, which now goes to the Senate, parliament's upper chamber, for scrutiny before it can be submitted to the prime minister and the king for endorsement.

The Clean Air Bill started life as citizen-initiated legislation, first proposed by a coalition of NGOs in 2019 before being taken up by political parties and previous governments. Seven draft versions were later consolidated into a single bill.

The bill would require major emitters in industry, transport and agriculture to pay fees, fines or compensation for damage caused by pollution. It also seeks to trace supply chains, including agricultural imports, to ensure that products linked to open burning or transboundary haze do not escape scrutiny.

At present, air pollution in Thailand is governed by a patchwork of laws, and the new bill is intended to bring those fragmented rules under a more coordinated national framework, while giving local authorities more power to respond to pollution in their own areas.

Thailand's air pollution crisis is most severe during the dry season, especially from December to April, when agricultural burning, forest fires, traffic and industrial emissions combine with stagnant weather.

In 2023, around 10 million people sought medical care for pollution-related illnesses, according to environmental reporting. PM2.5, fine particulate matter small enough to enter the bloodstream though the lungs , is the main concern.

According to the World Health Organization, air pollution contributes to more than 32,000 premature deaths in Thailand each year, including illnesses affecting the heart and lungs.

The bill introduces and endorses many progressive policy instruments. It requires authorities to reallocate budgets to support clean-air management and to collect pollution taxes. It provides for local ordinances, pollution control zones and area-specific air quality standards.

The bill would also create stronger air-quality monitoring systems, integrate pollution data across agencies and empower local governments to take action when pollution exceeds safe levels.

It includes measures against open burning, stronger regulation of high-emitting sectors and provisions covering transboundary pollution from outside Thailand.

The bill also envisages a Clean Air Fund that would support pollution reduction, public-health responses and assistance for...
body.zh: 季节性烟雾是泰国的一个主要公共卫生问题。拖延已久的立法旨在防患于未然，但执行可能会带来问题。 泰国议会恢复了拖延已久的立法，承认清洁空气是一项受保护的公共权利，对于这个季节性雾霾已成为年度卫生紧急事件的国家来说，这是迈出的重要一步。 上周，议员们以 611 票对 3 票通过了《清洁空气法案》，该法案现已提交议会上议院参议院进行审查，然后才能提交给首相和国王批准。 《清洁空气法案》最初是由公民发起的立法，最初由非政府组织联盟于 2019 年提出，随后被各政党和历届政府采纳。七个草案版本后来合并为一个法案。 该法案将要求工业、交通和农业的主要排放者缴纳费用、罚款或对污染造成的损害进行赔偿。它还寻求追踪供应链，包括农产品进口，以确保与露天焚烧或跨境雾霾有关的产品不会逃脱审查。 目前，泰国的空气污染问题由多种法律管辖，新法案旨在将这些零散的规则纳入更加协调的国家框架之下，同时赋予地方当局更大的权力来应对本地区的污染。 泰国的空气污染危机在旱季最为严重，尤其是12月至4月，此时农业燃烧、森林火灾、交通和工业排放以及停滞的天气相结合。 根据环境报告，到 2023 年，约有 1000 万人因污染相关疾病寻求医疗护理。 PM2.5（小到足以通过肺部进入血液的细颗粒物）是主要问题。 据世界卫生组织称，空气污染每年导致泰国超过 32,000 人过早死亡，其中包括影响心脏和肺部的疾病。 该法案引入并认可了许多进步的政策工具。它要求当局重新分配预算以支持清洁空气管理并征收污染税。它规定了地方法令、污染控制区和特定地区的空气质量标准。 该法案还将建立更强大的空气质量监测系统，整合各机构的污染数据，并授权地方政府在污染超过安全水平时采取行动。 它包括反对露天焚烧的措施、对高排放行业加强监管以及涵盖泰国境外跨境污染的规定。 该法案还设想设立一个清洁空气基金，以支持减少污染、公共卫生应对措施和援助……

reflection.en: The effort to pass and enforce legislation against toxic smog highlights the vital role of governance in protecting public health and the environment. As leaders strive to enact righteous policies, their true impact rests on diligent and equitable implementation for the well-being of all citizens.
reflection.zh: 泰国为应对有毒雾霾而努力通过并执行立法，这凸显了政府在保护公众健康和环境方面的关键作用。当领导者努力制定公正的政策时，其真正的影响力在于为所有公民的福祉而勤勉且公平地执行这些政策。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: South Africa's response to xenophobia is under fire
title.zh: 南非应对仇外情绪的措施受到抨击

summary.en: South Africa's government faces criticism for its handling of xenophobic violence. While condemning incidents, critics point to weak prevention, limited arrests, and political rhetoric that exacerbates tensions rather than easing them.
summary.zh: 南非政府因其处理仇外暴力的方式而受到批评。尽管政府谴责此类事件，但批评者指出，预防措施薄弱，逮捕人数有限，而且政治言论有时非但没有缓解反而加剧了紧张局势。

body.en:
South Africa's government condemns xenophobic violence when it erupts, but critics say prevention is weak, arrests are limited, and political rhetoric sometimes fuels tensions instead of easing them.

As attacks on migrants resurface in parts of South Africa , critics are questioning whether the government's response to xenophobia is working.

South Africa has faced repeated outbreaks of violence targeting migrants from Zimbabwe, Nigeria, Somalia, Ethiopia, Malawi, Mozambique, Ghana and Zambia. Earlier this month, Nigeria summoned South Africa's acting high commissioner , citing the growing anti-African migrant protests.

More than 60 people were killed in anti-immigrant riots in 2008, while similar unrest resurfaced in 2015 and 2016. Armed mobs attacked foreign-owned businesses around the city of Johannesburg in 2019, leaving at least 12 people dead — 10 of them South African citizens.

The violence is often linked to frustrations over unemployment, crime, overcrowded services and poor living conditions — grievances that are frequently redirected toward migrants.

However, Loren Landau, a senior migration researcher at University of the Witwatersrand's (Wits) African Centre for Migration and Society in Johannesburg, argued that the roots run deeper.

"The scapegoating and demonisation of migrants merely draw people's attention away from the true source of South Africa's problems and erodes democracy while putting the welfare of many people — both our own citizens and foreigners — at risk," Landau said in an article published by Wits on May 21.

"Migrants are not the source of any of South Africa's challenges. There are too few to make a substantial impact on employment or crime," he added.

South Africa's government has said it condemns violence against foreign nationals and is working to strengthen social cohesion and migration management.

Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola recently warned against civilians taking immigration enforcement into their own hands.

"It is not the responsibility of civilians to enforce the law," Lamola told DW. "Where people are told, 'You are not South African, you must go home,' that is xenophobia."

Lamola rejected claims that targeting migrants would solve South Africa's economic problems.

"The economic challenges and unemployment issues will not be resolved by chasing anyone," Lamola said. "This is not just a security issue, it is an economic and social issue."

Cabinet Minister Khumbudzo Ntshavheni also defended government efforts while condemning vigilantism.

"We cannot allow anyone who is not law enforcement to demand people's passports," she said.

Groups such as Operation Dudula , which campaigns against undocumented migration, have become increasingly influential in public...
body.zh: 南非政府在仇外暴力爆发时予以谴责，但批评人士表示，预防措施薄弱，逮捕人数有限，政治言论有时会加剧而不是缓解紧张局势。 随着针对移民的袭击在南非部分地区重新出现，批评者质疑政府应对仇外心理的措施是否有效。 南非多次面临针对津巴布韦、尼日利亚、索马里、埃塞俄比亚、马拉维、莫桑比克、加纳和赞比亚移民的暴力事件。 本月早些时候，尼日利亚以反非洲移民抗议活动不断升级为由，召见了南非代理高级专员。 2008 年，反移民骚乱造成 60 多人死亡，而类似的骚乱在 2015 年和 2016 年再次出现。2019 年，武装暴徒袭击了约翰内斯堡市周围的外资企业，造成至少 12 人死亡，其中 10 人是南非公民。 暴力往往与失业、犯罪、服务过度拥挤和生活条件恶劣等不满情绪有关，而这些不满情绪往往会指向移民。 然而，位于约翰内斯堡的威特沃特斯兰德大学非洲移民与社会中心的高级移民研究员洛伦·兰道（Loren Landau）认为，根源更为深刻。 兰道在 Wits 5 月 21 日发表的一篇文章中表示：“对移民的替罪羊和妖魔化只会让人们的注意力从南非问题的真正根源上转移开，并侵蚀民主，同时使许多人——包括我们自己的公民和外国人——的福祉面临风险。” “移民不是南非任何挑战的根源。移民人数太少，无法对就业或犯罪产生重大影响，”他补充道。 南非政府表示谴责针对外国人的暴力行为，并正在努力加强社会凝聚力和移民管理。 外交部长罗纳德·拉莫拉最近警告平民不要自行负责移民执法。 拉莫拉告诉德国之声：“执行法律不是平民的责任。” “人们被告知，‘你不是南非人，你必须回家’，这就是仇外心理。” 拉莫拉否认针对移民可以解决南非经济问题的说法。 拉莫拉说：“经济挑战和失业问题不会通过追逐任何人来解决。” “这不仅仅是一个安全问题，更是一个经济和社会问题。” 内阁部长昆布佐·恩沙夫尼 (Khumbudzo Ntshavheni) 也为政府的努力辩护，同时谴责私刑活动。 “我们不能允许任何非执法人员索要人们的护照，”她说。 杜杜拉行动（Operation Dudula）等反对无证移民的团体在公众中的影响力越来越大……

reflection.en: The biblical call to treat the stranger as native-born reminds us of the profound dignity inherent in every person, regardless of origin. When societies struggle with xenophobia, it highlights a collective challenge to uphold justice and compassion for all who reside among us.
reflection.zh: 圣经呼吁我们对待寄居者如同本地人，这提醒我们每个人都拥有深刻的尊严，无论其出身如何。当社会面临仇外情绪的挑战时，这凸显了我们共同的责任，即为所有居住在我们中间的人维护正义和怜悯。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Trump administration to end in-country applications for US permanent residency
title.zh: 特朗普政府将终止在美国境内申请美国永久居留的程序

summary.en: The Trump administration announced an end to in-country applications for US permanent residency, marking another measure to tighten legal immigration processes.
summary.zh: 特朗普政府宣布将终止在美国境内申请永久居留的程序，这是其收紧美国合法移民政策的最新举措。

body.en:
Foreigners in the United States who want a green card will need to leave and apply in their home country, the Trump administration has announced, in a surprise change to a longstanding policy.

For more than half a century, foreign nationals with legal status have been able to apply for and complete the entire process for permanent residence in the US — including individuals married to US citizens, holders of work and student visas, and refugees and political asylum seekers, among others.

The announcement from US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) said foreigners who are in America temporarily and who want to apply to become lawful permanent residents, or green card holders, have to return home and apply there, except in "extraordinary circumstances".

"Nonimmigrants, like students, temporary workers, or people on tourist visas, come to the US for a short time and for a specific purpose. Our system is designed for them to leave when their visit is over. Their visit should not function as the first step in the Green Card process," the agency said in a statement on Friday, local time.

It is the latest step by the Trump administration to make legal immigration more difficult for foreigners already in the US and for those hoping to come here.

Doug Rand, a former senior advisor at USCIS during the Biden administration, said the goal of the policy change was "very explicit".

"Senior officials in this administration have said over and over that they want fewer people to get permanent residency because permanent residency is a path to citizenship, and they want to block that path for as many people as possible," he said.

Rand said about 600,000 people already in the US apply each year for a green card.

USCIS did not say when the change would come into effect, whether individuals would be required to remain in another country throughout the entire process, or whether the policy impacts foreigners whose green card applications are already underway.

In an emailed statement to the Associated Press, the agency said people who provide an "economic benefit" or "national interest" could likely stay in the US, while others would have to go abroad to apply.

The changes come on top of steps the administration has already taken to restrict and limit entry for people from dozens of countries.

USCIS described the change as a return to "the original intent of the law" and closing a "loophole".

title.en: SpaceX launches biggest model of Starship megarocket
title.zh: SpaceX发射最大型号星舰巨型火箭

summary.en: SpaceX has launched its biggest Starship yet as the company races against Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin for space exploration dominance.
summary.zh: SpaceX已成功发射其迄今为止最大的星舰火箭，这加剧了其与杰夫·贝佐斯旗下蓝色起源公司在太空探索领域主导地位的竞争。

body.en:
SpaceX has launched its biggest, most powerful Starship yet on a test flight, an upgraded version that NASA is counting on to land astronauts on the moon.

The redesigned mega rocket made its debut two days after SpaceX chief Elon Musk announced he's taking the company public in a potentially record initial public offering.

The rocket blasted off from the southern tip of Texas, carrying 20 mock Starlink satellites for release halfway around the world.

The mammoth rocket blasted off into space at just after 5.30 pm local time. It completed the test before splashing down into the Indian Ocean on Friday.

It's the 12th test flight of the rocket that Musk is building to get people to Mars one day. But first comes the moon and NASA's Artemis program.

The last of the old space-skimming Starships lifted off in October. SpaceX's third-generation Starship — a souped-up version dubbed V3 — soared from a brand-new launch pad at Starbase, near the Mexican border.

SpaceX was hoping to avoid the fireworks it experienced during back-to-back launches in 2025 when midair explosions rained wreckage down on the Atlantic. Earlier flights also ended in flames.

At 124 metres, the latest model eclipses the older Starship lines by more than a metre and packs more engine thrust.

The revamped booster sports fewer but bigger and stronger grid fins for steering it back to earth following liftoff, and a larger and more robust fuel transfer line to feed the 33 main engines.

The retro-looking, stainless steel spacecraft also has more of everything — more cameras and more navigation and computer power — as well as docking cones for future rendezvous and moon missions.

Starship is meant to be fully reusable, with giant mechanical arms at the launch pads to catch the returning rocket stages. But on this latest trial run, nothing was being recovered.

NASA is paying SpaceX — and Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin — billions of dollars to provide the lunar landers that will be used to land Artemis astronauts on the moon.

While Starship has reached the fringes of space on multiple flights lasting an hour at most, Bezos' Blue Moon has yet to lift off, although a prototype is being readied for a moonshot later in 2026.

NASA is following April's successful lunar flyaround by four astronauts with a docking trial run in orbit around earth planned for 2027.

For that Artemis III mission, astronauts will practice docking their Orion capsule with Starship, Blue Moon or both.

A moon landing by two astronauts — Artemis IV— could follow as soon as 2028 using either Starship or Blue Moon, whichever lander is safer and ready first.

It will be NASA's first lunar landing with a crew since 1972's Apollo 17. The goal this time is a moon base near...
body.zh: SpaceX 已经在试飞中发射了迄今为止最大、最强大的星际飞船，这是 NASA 指望将宇航员送上月球的升级版本。 两天前，SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 宣布，他将让该公司以可能创纪录的首次公开募股 (IPO) 方式上市，两天后，这款重新设计的巨型火箭首次亮相。 这艘火箭从德克萨斯州南端发射升空，运载着 20 颗模拟星链卫星，将发射到半个地球。 当地时间下午 5 点 30 分刚过，这艘巨大的火箭发射升空。它在周五溅入印度洋之前完成了测试。 这是马斯克正在建造的火箭的第 12 次试飞，目的是有一天将人们送上火星。但首先是月球和美国宇航局的阿尔忒弥斯计划。 最后一艘老式掠空星舰于十月升空。 SpaceX 的第三代星际飞船——一个名为 V3 的增强版——从靠近墨西哥边境的 Starbase 的全新发射台升空。 SpaceX 希望避免 2025 年连续发射时发生的烟火事件，当时空中爆炸将残骸如雨点般落到大西洋上。早些时候的航班也因火灾而结束。 最新型号的高度为 124 米，比旧款 Starship 系列高出一米多，并且发动机推力更大。 改进后的助推器配备了更少但更大、更强的网格翅片，用于在升空后将其引导回地面，以及更大、更坚固的燃油传输管线，为 33 个主发动机提供燃料。 这艘外观复古的不锈钢航天器还拥有更多的东西——更多的摄像头、更多的导航和计算机能力——以及用于未来交会和月球任务的对接锥体。 星舰应该是完全可重复使用的，发射台上有巨大的机械臂来捕捉返回的火箭级。但在最近的这次试运行中，没有任何恢复。 NASA 正在向 SpaceX 和杰夫·贝佐斯的蓝色起源公司支付数十亿美元，以提供用于将阿耳忒弥斯宇航员送上月球的月球着陆器。 虽然 Starship 已经通过最多持续一小时的多次飞行到达太空边缘，但贝索斯的蓝月亮尚未升空，尽管原型机已准备好在 2026 年晚些时候进行登月。 继 4 月份四名宇航员成功绕月飞行之后，美国宇航局 (NASA) 计划于 2027 年在绕地轨道上进行对接试运行。 在阿耳忒弥斯三号任务中，宇航员将练习将猎户座太空舱与星舰、蓝月亮或两者对接。 两名宇航员——阿耳忒弥斯四号——最早可能于 2028 年使用“星际飞船”或“蓝月亮”登陆月球，以更安全且先准备好的着陆器为准。 这将是美国宇航局自 1972 年阿波罗 17 号以来首次载人登月。这次的目标是......

title.en: Tulsi Gabbard resigns as top US intelligence official
title.zh: 图尔西·加巴德辞去美国高级情报官员职务

summary.en: Tulsi Gabbard, the first Hindu member of the White House and a former presidential candidate, has resigned from her position as a top US intelligence official. She is widely known for her consistent opposition to foreign wars.
summary.zh: 首位进入白宫的印度教徒、前总统候选人图尔西·加巴德已辞去美国高级情报官员的职务。她以一贯反对对外战争而闻名。

body.en:
Tulsi Gabbard will resign as the United States director of national intelligence, saying she has to step away as her husband battles cancer.

Her husband had been diagnosed ‌with a rare form of bone cancer, and she is leaving her role to help him.

Gabbard advised US President Donald Trump of her intention to step down during a meeting at the White House on Friday, with the resignation effective 30 June, according to Fox News Digital.

In her resignation letter posted on X, Gabbard told Trump she was "deeply grateful for the trust you placed in me and for the opportunity to lead the Office of the Director of National Intelligence for the last year and a half".

She cited ⁠her husband's recent diagnosis with ‌a rare form of bone cancer.

"I cannot in good conscience ask him to face this fight alone while ‌I continue in this demanding and time-consuming post," she said.

However, a source familiar with ‌the matter told Reuters that Gabbard ⁠had been forced out by the White House.

In a post on his Truth Social platform, Trump said the principal deputy director of national intelligence, Aaron Lukas, would serve as acting director of national intelligence.

He said Gabbard had done "an incredible job" but with her husband diagnosed with ‌bone cancer, "she, rightfully, wants to be with him, bringing him back to good health as they currently fight a tough battle together".

Trump has hinted in the past at differences with Gabbard on their approach to Iran, saying in March that she was "softer" than him on curbing Iran's nuclear ambitions.

Gabbard, a veteran and former Democratic congresswoman from Hawaii, built her political name on her opposition to foreign wars.

This put her in an awkward position when the US joined Israel in launching attacks on Iran on 28 February.

During a congressional hearing in March, her measured comments were notable for their careful non-endorsement of the decision to strike Iran.

She dodged questions about whether the White House had been warned of potential fallout from the conflict, including Iran's effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

"It is not the intelligence community's responsibility to determine what is and is not an imminent threat," she said.

Gabbard ran for president in 2020 on a progressive platform and her opposition to US involvement in foreign military conflicts.

Citing her military experience, she argued that wars in the Middle East had destabilised the region, made the US less safe and cost thousands of lives.

Gabbard later dropped out of the race and endorsed the ultimate winner, Joe Biden.

Two years later, she left the Democratic party to become an independent, saying her old party was dominated by an "elitist cabal of warmongers" and "woke"...
body.zh: 图尔西·加巴德将辞去美国国家情报总监一职，称由于丈夫与癌症作斗争，她必须辞职。 她的丈夫被诊断出患有一种罕见的骨癌，她将辞去自己的职务来帮助他。 据福克斯新闻数字报道，加巴德在周五的白宫会议上向美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示她打算辞职，辞职于 6 月 30 日生效。 在 X 上发布的辞职信中，加巴德告诉特朗普，她“非常感谢您对我的信任，以及在过去一年半里有机会领导国家情报总监办公室”。 她引用了她丈夫最近被诊断出患有一种罕见骨癌的例子。 她说：“凭良心来说，我不能要求他独自面对这场战斗，而我则继续担任这个要求很高且耗时的职位。” 然而，一位知情人士告诉路透社，加巴德是被白宫逼出来的。 特朗普在其“真相社交”平台上发帖称，国家情报局首席副局长亚伦·卢卡斯将担任代理国家情报局局长。 他说加巴德做了“一项令人难以置信的工作”，但由于她的丈夫被诊断出患有骨癌，“她理所当然地想和他在一起，让他恢复健康，因为他们目前正在共同进行一场艰苦的战斗”。 特朗普过去曾暗示与加巴德在处理伊朗问题上存在分歧，并在三月份表示，她在遏制伊朗核野心方面比他“软弱”。 加巴德是一位来自夏威夷的退伍军人、前民主党女议员，她因反对对外战争而声名鹊起。 当美国2月28日与以色列一起对伊朗发动袭击时，这让她处于尴尬的境地。 在三月份的国会听证会上，她谨慎的评论因谨慎地不支持打击伊朗的决定而引人注目。 她回避了有关白宫是否已收到有关冲突潜在后果的警告的问题，其中包括伊朗有效关闭霍尔木兹海峡。 “情报界没有责任确定什么是迫在眉睫的威胁，什么不是迫在眉睫的威胁，”她说。 加巴德以进步纲领和反对美国卷入外国军事冲突的立场竞选 2020 年总统。 她援引自己的军事经验，认为中东战争破坏了该地区的稳定，使美国变得更加不安全，并造成数千人丧生。 加巴德后来退出竞选并支持最终获胜者乔·拜登。 两年后，她离开民主党成为独立党，称她的旧党由“战争贩子精英集团”主导，并“觉醒”了……

title.en: Second IS-linked group attempting return faces 'same consequences', Plibersek says
title.zh: 普利伯塞克说，第二个与伊斯兰国有关的组织试图返回面临“同样的后果”

summary.en: It's believed the cohort will travel to Australia from Damascus after leaving Syria's al-Roj detention camp.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A second group of Australian women and children with links to the self-described Islamic State (IS) group have reportedly left a refugee camp in Syria.

Federal minister Tanya Plibersek told the ABC on Friday they would "face the same consequences as the first group".

"If there are any crimes that they're accused of, they'll be taken into custody and treated with the full force of the law," she said.

The group left the al-Roj detention camp on Thursday local time, according to the ABC, which reported it had seen the bus carrying the group.

The bus was reportedly travelling in a convoy escorted by Syrian government officials. It's believed all Australians at the camp have now departed, however camp officials declined to comment.

It is expected they will head towards the capital Damascus for flights returning to Australia, but the timing remains unclear.

It comes after a group of four women and nine children with ties to the IS group arrived in Australia earlier in May after leaving the same refugee camp.

Three of the women in that group were arrested upon their arrival and remain in custody.

Two are facing charges relating to slavery, and the other was charged with joining a terrorist organisation and travelling to a declared conflict zone.

It is understood seven women and 14 children remained at the Syrian al-Roj camp following the departure of the first group.

One of the women has been given a temporary exclusion order, which bans them from entering Australia for a two-year period on national security grounds.

The group can to return to Australia from the refugee camp as they are citizens, but Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has insisted no support has been given to them.

"The US State Department has been very keen on people leaving those camps," he told ABC Radio on Wednesday.

"There wasn't a government person on the plane [with the previous cohort], because we weren't providing any assistance, and won't."

The group is part of at least 34 Australian citizens — mainly women and children — who have been stuck in diplomatic limbo in the al-Roj camp since 2019 following the collapse of the IS group.

The story has generated significant political debate and scrutiny of the government, which has limited powers to prevent Australian citizens from returning home.

The government has firmly stated it has not assisted the group in any way, after facing Opposition backlash and accusations of facilitating the return. The government was under obligation to provide the group with passports and did so earlier this year.

body.zh: 据报道，第二批与自称为伊斯兰国（IS）组织有联系的澳大利亚妇女和儿童已离开叙利亚的难民营。 联邦部长塔尼娅·普利伯塞克 (Tanya Plibersek) 周五告诉美国广播公司 (ABC)，他们将“面临与第一批人相同的后果”。 她说：“如果他们被指控犯有任何罪行，他们将被拘留并受到法律的全力对待。” 据美国广播公司报道，这群人于当地时间周四离开 al-Roj 拘留营，并报道称他们看到了载着这群人的巴士。 据报道，这辆巴士是在叙利亚政府官员的护送下行驶的。据信营地中的所有澳大利亚人现已离开，但营地官员拒绝发表评论。 预计他们将飞往首都大马士革搭乘航班返回澳大利亚，但具体时间仍不清楚。 此前，与伊斯兰国组织有联系的四名妇女和九名儿童在离开同一难民营后于五月初抵达澳大利亚。 该团体中的三名妇女在抵达后被捕并仍被拘留。 两人面临与奴隶制有关的指控，另一人被指控加入恐怖组织并前往已宣布的冲突地区。 据了解，第一批人离开后，7 名妇女和 14 名儿童仍留在叙利亚 al-Roj 营地。 其中一名妇女已获得临时排除令，以国家安全为由禁止她们在两年内进入澳大利亚。 这群人可以因为是公民而从难民营返回澳大利亚，但总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞坚称没有向他们提供任何支持。 “美国国务院一直非常希望人们离开这些营地，”他周三告诉美国广播公司广播电台。 “（前一批人）飞机上没有政府人员，因为我们没有提供任何援助，也不会提供任何援助。” 该组织是至少 34 名澳大利亚公民（主要是妇女和儿童）的一部分，自 2019 年伊斯兰国组织瓦解以来，这些澳大利亚公民一直在 al-Roj 营地陷入外交困境。 这个故事引起了重大的政治辩论和政府的审查，政府阻止澳大利亚公民回国的权力有限。 在面临反对派的强烈反对和为返回提供便利的指控后，政府坚定地表示，它没有以任何方式帮助该组织。政府有义务向该团体提供护照，并于今年早些时候这样做了。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: Indo-Pacific security in focus as US, India, Japan and Australia ministers meet
title.zh: 美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚部长会晤印太安全成为焦点

summary.en: Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.

Foreign ministers from the United States , India, Japan and Australia — the four nations that make up the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, better known as the Quad — are set to meet in New Delhi over three days startng Sunday to discuss Indo-Pacific security, energy supplies and emerging technologies.

The meeting comes as China continues to test geopolitical and security boundaries in the region.

But it's another issue, which is not on the agenda, that looms large over the gathering: how to keep the alliance alive and relevant in an ever more challenging geopolitical landscape and an increasingly assertive China .

The Quad, which unites the four nations in seeking a Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP), has not had a meeting of national leaders since 2024, when then-President Joe Biden hosted his counterparts in Wilmington, Delaware.

India was meant to host the next annual meeting in the latter part of 2025, but that never materialized amid tensions between India and the new administration of President Donald Trump .

Trump has imposed tariffs and punitive duties on Indian imports to the US, straining ties with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The US president further antagonized New Delhi by claiming to have mediated a settlement to border clashes between India and Pakistan in May last year . The US president was also critical of India purchasing Russian military equipment .

One year on, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is heading the US delegation to India, is tasked with smoothing ruffled diplomatic feathers. With Trump's attention apparently focused on the war in the Middle East and, potentially, Cuba , Rubio's mission could be a challenging one.

"The US, Japan and Australia already had an important and effective trilateral security arrangement, but the whole purpose of the Quad was to bring India in as another power to give it more influence and reach," said James Brown, a professor of international relations at the Tokyo campus of Temple University.

"Unfortunately, this US administration does not seem to have grasped that or valued India's presence as an ally, which has badly alienated Modi," he told DW.

Japan and Australia have made efforts to keep the four-way alliance intact and functioning, with Brown suggesting that the Quad might actually benefit from the US being represented by Rubio, rather than Trump, in India.

body.zh: 如果该联盟要继续成为对抗中国的有效手段，美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚（统称为“四方”）的外交部长就需要将过去的分歧抛在脑后。 来自美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚这四个国家的外交部长将于周日开始在新德里举行为期三天的会议，讨论印太安全、能源供应和新兴技术。 这次会议召开之际，中国正在继续测试该地区的地缘政治和安全边界。 但另一个未列入议程的问题在这次会议上显得尤为突出：如何在日益具有挑战性的地缘政治格局和日益自信的中国中保持联盟的活力和相关性。 四方联盟将四个国家团结起来，寻求自由开放的印度太平洋地区 (FOIP)，自 2024 年时任总统乔·拜登在特拉华州威尔明顿接待各国领导人以来，该组织就没有举行过国家领导人会议。 印度原定于 2025 年下半年主办下一次年度会议，但由于印度与唐纳德·特朗普总统新政府之间的紧张关系，这一目标从未实现。 特朗普对印度输美产品征收关税和惩罚性关税，导致与印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的关系紧张。这位美国总统去年五月声称已通过调解解决了印度和巴基斯坦之间的边境冲突，这进一步激怒了新德里。美国总统还批评印度购买俄罗斯军事装备。 一年后，率领美国代表团访问印度的国务卿马可·卢比奥肩负着平息外交争端的任务。由于特朗普的注意力显然集中在中东战争以及可能的古巴战争上，卢比奥的任务可能是一项具有挑战性的任务。 天普大学东京校区国际关系学教授詹姆斯·布朗表示：“美国、日本和澳大利亚已经达成了重要且有效的三边安全安排，但四方机制的全部目的是让印度成为另一个大国，以赋予其更大的影响力和影响力。” 他告诉德国之声：“不幸的是，本届美国政府似乎没有认识到这一点，也没有重视印度作为盟友的存在，这严重疏远了莫迪。” 日本和澳大利亚一直在努力保持四方联盟的完整和运作，布朗表示，四方联盟实际上可能会受益于卢比奥而不是特朗普在印度代表美国。 南加州大学教授德里克·格罗斯曼在《外交政策》杂志上撰文警告说，如果特朗普拒绝参加下一次领导人会议，可能会……

title.en: China: Dozens dead in coal mine blast — state media
title.zh: 中国：国家媒体称煤矿爆炸导致数十人死亡

summary.en: An explosion in a coal mine in northern China has resulted in the deaths of at least 82 people, with some individuals still missing. President Xi Jinping has called for comprehensive efforts to search for and rescue those unaccounted for.
summary.zh: 中国北方一座煤矿发生爆炸，造成至少82人死亡，仍有部分人员失踪。国家主席习近平已要求“全力以赴”搜寻和营救失踪人员。

body.en:
An explosion in a coal mine in northern China has killed at least 82 people, with some still unaccounted for, state media say. President Xi Jinping has demanded an "all-out" effort to search for and rescue those missing.

At least 92 people have died after a gas explosion at a coal mine in northern China , state media reported on Saturday.

Rescuers were still searching "intensively" for nine people who remained unaccounted for, according to state news agency Xinhua.

Over 120 were hospitalized for injuries from the blast, many of them suffering from the toxic gas.

The blast took place at 7:29 pm (1129 GMT/UTC) on Friday at the Liushenyu coal mine in Qinyuan county in Shanxi, one of China's poorer provinces, with 247 ⁠workers ​on duty ​underground, Xinhua said.

Xinhua reported that most had been brought safely to ​the surface by early Saturday.

Earlier, Xinhua said that levels of carbon monoxide had "exceeded limits" at the mine. Some of those trapped underground were in "critical condition," it said.

Chinese President Xi Jinping urged authorities to "spare no ‌effort" in treating the injured and conducting ‌search ​and rescue operations, according to Xinhua.

Xi also ordered a thorough investigation into the cause of the accident and strict ​accountability in accordance with the law.

He stressed that "all regions and departments must draw lessons from this accident, remain constantly vigilant regarding workplace safety ... and resolutely prevent and curb the occurrence of major and catastrophic accidents."

In recent decades, mine safety in China has improved, but accidents are still frequent in an industry where safety protocols are often lax.

body.zh: 官方媒体称，中国北方一座煤矿发生爆炸，已造成至少 82 人死亡，其中一些人仍下落不明。习近平主席要求“全力以赴”搜寻和营救失踪人员。 据官方媒体周六报道，中国北方一处煤矿瓦斯爆炸已造成至少 82 人死亡。 据官方通讯社新华社报道，救援人员仍在“密集”搜寻九名下落不明的人。 新华社称，爆炸发生在周五晚上 7 点 29 分（格林尼治标准时间/世界标准时间 1129 点），发生在中国较贫困的省份之一山西省沁源县的六神峪煤矿，当时有 247 名工人在井下执勤。 新华社报道说，到周六早些时候，大多数人已被安全地带到地面。 早些时候，新华社称该矿的一氧化碳含量“超出了限制”。报告称，一些被困地下的人“情况危急”。 据新华社报道，中国国家主席习近平敦促当局“不遗余力”救治伤者并开展搜救行动。 习近平还责令彻查事故原因，依法严肃问责。 他强调，“各地区、各部门要深刻汲取这次事故的教训，时刻保持安全生产意识……坚决预防和遏制重特大事故发生。” 近几十年来，中国的矿山安全有所改善，但安全规程往往不严的行业事故仍然频发。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life in the coal mine explosion leaves many families brokenhearted and crushed in spirit. In such moments of profound grief and uncertainty, we are reminded that 雅伟 is near to those who suffer. May comfort and strength be found by all affected, especially those awaiting news of their loved ones.

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

title.en: US arms sales to Taiwan on ‘pause’ due to Iran war, says acting navy chief
title.zh: 美国代理海军部长称，对台湾的军售因伊朗战争而“暂停”

summary.en: Washington's acting navy secretary stated that US arms sales to Taiwan have been temporarily halted. This pause is to ensure sufficient munitions are available for ongoing US military operations in Iran, adding to recent doubts about sustained US support for Taipei.
summary.zh: 华盛顿代理海军部长表示，美国对台湾的军售已暂停。此举是为了确保美国军方有足够的弹药用于其在伊朗的军事行动，这进一步加剧了近期对美国能否持续支持台北的疑虑。

body.en: Hung Cao’s comments are latest blow to Taipei after Donald Trump recently cast doubt over US’s enduring support US arms sales to Taiwan have been “paused” to ensure the US military has enough munitions for its Iran operations, according to Washington’s acting navy secretary, in the latest blow to Taipei after a series of comments by Donald Trump. When asked at a congressional hearing on Thursday about a $14bn (£10.4bn) weapons package awaiting Trump’s signoff for months, Hung Cao said: “Right now we’re doing a pause in order to make sure we have the munitions we need for Epic Fury [the Iran war] – which we have plenty.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 华盛顿代理海军部长表示，唐纳德·特朗普最近对美国的持久支持表示怀疑，美国已“暂停”对台军售，以确保美军有足够的弹药用于其伊朗行动，曹洪的言论是对台北的最新打击。这是唐纳德·特朗普发表一系列言论后对台北的最新打击。在周四的国会听证会上，当被问及等待特朗普签署数月之久的价值 140 亿美元（104 亿英镑）的武器计划时，曹洪表示：“现在我们正在暂停，以确保我们拥有史诗般的愤怒（伊朗战争）所需的弹药——我们有足够的弹药。”继续阅读...

The prophet Isaiah envisioned a future where nations would transform instruments of war into tools for peace, no longer training for battle. This vision calls us to hope for a day when global resources are dedicated to...

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Weather tracker: Heavy rain triggers flooding and landslides in parts of China
title.zh: 中国部分地区持续强降雨引发洪灾和山体滑坡

summary.en: Heavy, prolonged rainfall in southern and central China has caused widespread flooding and landslides, leading to the deaths of twelve people. The severe weather has also resulted in significant travel disruption, electricity outages, and evacuations across affected areas.
summary.zh: 中国南方和中部地区持续强降雨引发大范围洪水和山体滑坡，已造成十二人死亡。恶劣天气还导致受灾地区交通中断、电力供应中断，并进行了人员疏散。

body.en: Twelve dead as southern and central areas also suffer travel disruption, electricity outages and evacuations Heavy, prolonged rainfall in southern and central China has resulted in weather warnings for flash flooding, landslides and waterlogging. The slow-moving band of rainfall spanned 620 miles (1,000km) and travelled eastwards across the regions on Tuesday. It was formed from the convergence of multiple bands of rain originating from the Bay of Bengal, South China Sea and Pacific Ocean. Given the accompanying low wind speeds, high daily and hourly rainfall totals have been recorded, with as much as 75mm locally in Hunan, 85mm in Anhui in a 24-hour period, and 95mm on the island of Hainan. Twelve people have died because of the flooding and hundreds of residents have been evacuated by emergency services. There were major travel disruptions, electricity outages, as well as school and business closures. Social media posts showed submerged cars and people fishing along flooded streets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 南部和中部地区也遭遇出行中断、停电和疏散，造成 12 人死亡 中国南部和中部地区持续强降雨，引发山洪、山体滑坡和内涝天气警报。周二，降雨带横跨 1,000 公里（620 英里），并稳步向东移动穿过该地区。这是一条缓慢移动的雨带，由来自孟加拉湾、南中国海和太平洋的多个雨带汇聚而成。加上风速较低，日、小时降雨总量较高，湖南局部24小时降雨量高达75毫米，安徽24小时降雨量高达85毫米，海南岛24小时降雨量高达95毫米。洪水已造成 12 人死亡，数百名居民已被紧急服务部门疏散。出现了严重的旅行中断、停电以及学校和企业关闭的情况。沿着被洪水淹没的街道，社交媒体帖子显示汽车被淹没，人们在钓鱼。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of devastating floods and landslides, communities experience immense loss and disruption. Psalm 46:1 reminds us that even when the earth gives way, God remains our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble. This truth offers a steady anchor for those navigating the chaos and rebuilding their lives.
reflection.zh: 面对毁灭性的洪水和山体滑坡，社区遭受了巨大的损失和破坏。诗篇46:1提醒我们，即使大地动摇，雅伟仍是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。这个真理为那些在混乱中挣扎并重建生活的人们提供了稳固的锚。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Chinese authorities destroy villager’s ramshackle 10-storey Studio Ghibli-esque home
title.zh: 中国当局拆除村民破旧的十层吉卜力风格房屋

summary.en: Officials in Guizhou province, China, demolished a unique 10-storey home in Xingyi village. The unconventional structure had become a local tourist attraction, but authorities stated it lacked the necessary building permits.

body.en: The home in the village of Xingyi in Guizhou province had become a tourist attraction, but officials said it lacked the necessary building permits A ramshackle 10-storey home that had become an offbeat tourist attraction in south-western China has been torn down, ending a years-long battle between the structure’s owner and local authorities. Chen Tianming said local authorities took just hours to return the stone bungalow – which had been transformed into a pyramid-shaped structure of plywood rooms stacked upon one another – back down to its original single storey. verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
title.zh: 中国新监控系统让外国人无处藏身

summary.en: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."
summary.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声披露了中国高科技警务的详细信息。该系统利用滑雪场的面部识别和火车座位等技术，可以追踪任何人并建立“综合档案”，让外国人无处藏身。

body.en:
A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."

When a cybersecurity researcher known by the pseudonym NetAskari recently clicked on a tab labeled "Inquiry for journalist files" on an unsecured Chinese web dashboard, he expected to see a jumble of auto-generated mock data.

Instead, familiar faces popped up on the screen. It was a comprehensive database of almost every foreign journalist based in the Chinese capital Beijing around 2021, including official passport photos taken at the entry/exit bureau, private cell phone numbers, visa details, and dates of birth. He also found his own exact personal information lying dormant on this Chinese police watchlist.

"It was more interesting than shocking," NetAskari told DW. "When you work as a journalist in China , you basically assume you are always on their radar. But what surprised me was simply how easy it was to access this highly sensitive system."

What NetAskari had stumbled upon is part modern China's emerging system of "holographic profiles."

He had unwittingly accessed a demonstration version of a remote tracking system designed for the Public Security Bureau in Zhangjiakou, the Hebei province city that hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics.

Though it was only a test panel, it was populated with real datasets, clearly outlining the trajectory of China's state surveillance machine, which is rapidly evolving from a network of simple street cameras into a data-fused, 24/7, predictive social control behemoth.

For years, China has operated the world's most extensive CCTV network. A massive initiative known as the "Xueliang" (Bright Eyes) project aims to merge these isolated islands of surveillance spread across the country.

But the data on the Zhangjiakou police dashboard shows the granular detail with which authorities can track an individual.

This system no longer relies solely on police cameras on street corners. It accurately records the specific train carriage and seat number a target occupies when arriving from Beijing or Shanghai.

It even synchronizes photos taken by facial-recognition ticket gates at local ski resorts directly into its tracking mechanism. The movements of the researcher's acquaintances who recently skied in Zhangjiakou were precisely flagged and mapped out with detailed trajectories in the system.

"The idea is simply to process as much data as possible from as many sensors as possible in real time," the researcher noted.

The system logs daily behaviors like gasoline consumption, regular shopping locations, and whether an individual frequently visits "petition areas."

body.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。从滑雪场面部识别到火车座位，该系统可以跟踪任何人并编制“整体档案”。 当一位化名 NetAskari 的网络安全研究人员最近点击一个不安全的中文网络仪表板上标有“查询记者档案”的选项卡时，他预计会看到一堆自动生成的模拟数据。 取而代之的是，熟悉的面孔出现在屏幕上。这是 2021 年左右驻扎在中国首都北京的几乎所有外国记者的综合数据库，包括在出入境管理局拍摄的官方护照照片、私人手机号码、签证详细信息和出生日期。他还发现自己的确切个人信息隐藏在中国警方的监视名单上。 “这比令人震惊更有趣，”内特阿斯卡里告诉德国之声。 “当你在中国担任记者时，你基本上会认为你总是在他们的监视范围内。但令我惊讶的是访问这个高度敏感的系统是多么容易。” NetAskari 偶然发现的是现代中国新兴的“全息轮廓”系统的一部分。 他无意中访问了为主办 2022 年冬季奥运会的河北省张家口市公安局设计的远程跟踪系统演示版本。 虽然它只是一个测试面板，但它填充了真实的数据集，清楚地概述了中国国家监控机器的轨迹，该机器正在从简单的街道摄像头网络迅速演变为数据融合的、24/7、预测性的社会控制庞然大物。 多年来，中国运营着世界上最广泛的闭路电视网络。一项名为“雪亮”（明亮的眼睛）项目的大规模倡议旨在合并这些分布在全国各地的监视孤岛。 但张家口警方仪表板上的数据显示了当局可以追踪个人的详细信息。 该系统不再仅仅依赖街角的警察摄像头。它准确记录目标从北京或上海到达时所占用的具体火车车厢和座位号。 它甚至将当地滑雪场的面部识别检票口拍摄的照片直接同步到其跟踪机制中。研究人员最近在张家口滑雪的熟人的动作被精确标记，并在系统中绘制出详细的轨迹。 研究人员指出：“这个想法只是实时处理来自尽可能多的传感器的尽可能多的数据。” 该系统记录日常行为，例如汽油消耗、常规购物地点以及个人是否经常访问“请愿区”。 这项大规模的数据融合工作试图……

reflection.en: The news of pervasive surveillance systems highlights the immense power states can wield over individuals. When such power is unchecked, it can feel like living under constant scrutiny, eroding personal freedom and privacy. This reminds us of the biblical warning about rulers who oppress their people, creating an environment of fear rather than security.
reflection.zh: 普遍存在的监控系统新闻突显了国家对个人可能施加的巨大权力。当这种权力不受制约时，人们可能会感到生活在持续的审视之下，个人自由和隐私受到侵蚀。这提醒我们圣经中关于压迫人民、制造恐惧而非安全的统治者的警告。

verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Numbers of Tibetan exiles plummet as China tightens grip
title.zh: 西藏流亡者人数锐减，中国加强控制

summary.en: Fewer Tibetans are seeking exile, as escaping Beijing-controlled Tibet has become more complicated and dangerous. This drop raises questions about preserving the future of Tibetan culture.
summary.zh: 随着逃离北京控制下的西藏变得更加复杂和危险，寻求流亡的藏人数量正在减少。这一数字的下降引发了人们对西藏文化未来保护的担忧。

body.en:
Fewer Tibetans are seeking exile, as escaping Beijing-controlled Tibet has become more complicated and dangerous. The drop raises questions about preserving the future of Tibetan culture.

For decades, the steady flow of Tibetans escaping across the Himalayas into India and Nepal served as a barometer of conditions inside Tibet.

From the late 1990s through the mid‑2000s, several thousand Tibetans sought exile every year, bringing firsthand accounts of political restrictions, cultural pressures and daily life under Chinese rule. 

But data from the Central Tibetan Administration in Dharamsala, the de facto capital of Tibetans in exile where the 14th Dalai Lama also resides, has revealed a collapse in the number of newly arrived Tibetans

Between 1995 and 1999, more than 12,000 Tibetans successfully sought exile. In the past five years, that number has plummeted to just 81.

With fewer Tibetans able to leave, independent information is becoming scarcer. That has made Beijing's policies, like religious regulation, language reforms, or rural relocation, more opaque to the outside world.

This comes as Beijing is increasingly promoting its own narratives on development and stability in Tibet. 

Lobsang, a middle-aged man who left Tibet in 2010, said the drop in the number of exiles comes as China has tightened its grip.

"Since 2008, the security architecture within Tibet has undergone a total transformation," he told DW.

"What we see now is a high-tech surveillance web where every village, every monastery and every household is monitored. Reaching the border is now nearly impossible for the average Tibetan," he added. 

The data suggests that the steepest drop in exiles began after large-scale protests in 2008 that spread across Tibet ahead of the Beijing Summer Olympics, prompting a heavy security response from Chinese authorities.

In the years that followed, Beijing expanded policing, digital surveillance and border enforcement across the Tibetan Plateau. 

Chinese authorities say their policies in Tibet have improved living standards, built out infrastructure and reduced poverty, leading to fewer people leaving.

The Chinese government has invested heavily in infrastructure , urban development and public services across Tibetan regions. In the eyes of Beijing, the porous border was a liability.

"The young Tibetan population … is increasingly migrating to larger [Chinese] cities and seeking to benefit from the growing Chinese economy," said Atul Kumar, a fellow with the strategic studies program at the Delhi-based Observer Research Foundation (ORF) think tank.

reflection.en: This news highlights the plight of a people whose ability to seek freedom and preserve their heritage is increasingly constrained. In such times, the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves becomes ever more urgent. It reminds us to advocate for the rights and cultural survival of vulnerable communities worldwide.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了一个民族的困境，他们寻求自由和维护自身文化遗产的能力正日益受到限制。在这样的时刻，为那些无法为自己发声的人仗义执言的呼吁变得更加紧迫。它提醒我们要为世界各地弱势群体的权利和文化存续而发声。

title.en: 'My dear friend': Putin and Xi praise partnership during talks in Beijing
title.zh: “我的挚友”：普京和习近平在北京会谈中赞扬伙伴关系

summary.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping praised their partnership during talks in Beijing. China continues to be a significant and loyal economic partner to Russia, despite international economic and financial sanctions imposed on Russia by other countries.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯总统普京和中国国家主席习近平在北京会谈期间赞扬了两国伙伴关系。尽管其他国家对俄罗斯实施了经济和金融制裁，中国仍然是俄罗斯重要而忠诚的经济伙伴。

body.en:
Russian President Vladimir Putin has lauded his close ties with Chinese leader Xi Jinping, saying the nations are partners in trade and international affairs during bilateral talks in Beijing.

Xi welcomed Putin with a ceremony at the Great Hall of the People only days after meeting United States President Donald Trump.

The quick succession of Trump's and Putin's visits highlighted China's growing role as an international superpower, experts say.

Putin greeted Xi warmly as they met for the bilateral talks, describing the Chinese president as a "dear friend".

"We are truly delighted to see you. We keep in constant touch, both personally and through our aides in the government," he said.

Xi also stressed the "political mutual trust and strategic co-operation" between the countries, according to Chinese state media.

The two leaders have praised each other profusely in the past — Xi once describing Putin as his "best and most intimate friend".

Xi and Putin were set to focus on energy and security as well as their overall ties.

Chinese state media reported both parties agreed to extend a friendship treaty first signed in 2001.

China became Russia's top trading partner after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

China has said it is neutral in the conflict, maintaining trade ties with Russia despite economic and financial sanctions against Russia by the US and Europe.

China is the top customer for Russian oil and gas supplies, and Russia expects the war in Iran to increase the demand.

"The driving force behind economic co-operation is Russian-Chinese collaboration in the energy sector," Putin said.

"Amid the crisis in the Middle East, Russia continues to maintain its role as a reliable supplier of resources, while China remains a responsible consumer of these resources."

Xi stressed the need for the "complete cessation of hostilities" in the Middle East, according to Chinese state media.

"An early end to the conflict will help reduce disruptions to energy supply stability, the smooth flow of industrial and supply chains, and international trade order," Xi said.

A Russian presidential aide said earlier that Russia's oil exports to China grew by 35 per cent in the first quarter of 2026. Russia was also one of the biggest exporters of natural gas to China.

Putin said China and Russia's co-operation in foreign policy is "one of the key stabilising factors on the international stage".

In February 2022, just weeks before Russia invaded Ukraine, China and Russia announced a "no limits" partnership during a trip by Putin to Beijing.

Despite taking a neutral stance in the conflict, China supports Russia through frequent state visits, growing trade and joint military drills.

reflection.en: International partnerships often reflect a nation's values and priorities on the global stage. This verse reminds us that the choices nations make, especially in their alliances and economic dealings, contribute to their moral standing and reputation among the peoples of the world. title.en: Samuel's visa status made him easier to exploit. A new project hopes to help migrants like him
title.zh: 塞缪尔的签证身份使他更容易被利用。一个新项目希望帮助像他这样的移民

summary.en: Temporary visa holders experiencing workplace issues in NSW have a new place to turn to for help.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
After arriving in Sydney from Colombia, Samuel Zuluaga felt lucky to find an employer willing to sponsor his temporary work visa.

While the 23-year-old hoped the barber shop job would help him build a stable future, he was underpaid, missed out on superannuation payments and feared speaking up because his visa depended on him remaining with his employer.

"After about a year, I noticed my employer had stopped paying my superannuation," Zuluaga told SBS News.

"At that time, I didn't fully understand what that meant. I told myself it might be a mistake."

Zuluaga said he was reluctant to raise concerns because he feared jeopardising his work rights in Australia.

"One day, I complained when I was asked to clean the toilet, knowing that it wasn't my responsibility," he said.

"My employer just said, 'You are fired, pack your stuff and go home'. Just like that, I had lost my job and my visa sponsor."

Zuluaga also alleges he was denied payment for unused annual leave because he was too afraid to take time off work.

Eventually, with support from unions and advocacy services, he recovered the money he was owed.

"It wasn't just about the money. It changed my situation and showed me that I wasn't alone."

Zuluaga's experience reflects broader concerns raised in a recent report by the Migrant Justice Institute, which found nearly two-thirds of temporary visa holders surveyed had experienced underpayment.

The report also estimated that international students alone are losing more than $60 million in wages every week.

More than a third of respondents reported working under Australian Business Number (ABN) or contractor arrangements.

Previous reports have identified limited English, poor awareness of workplace rights and difficulty accessing support services as factors increasing the risk of exploitation.

Unions NSW president Mark Morey said that, despite this mistreatment, migrant workers played a critical role in Australia's economy.

"We know in farming communities, retail, hospitality and construction, we are all short of skilled labour and workers entering the economy."

The NSW government has now launched the state's first dedicated Migrant Workers Centre to support temporary visa holders experiencing workplace exploitation, unsafe conditions and underpayment.

The centre will provide workplace, safety and immigration support to vulnerable migrant workers across the state.

Backed by $6.5 million in funding over four years, the centre is expected to support around 2,000 at-risk workers annually through culturally sensitive and community-based services.

While it's based in Sydney's CBD, it has additional outreach services planned for regional communities.

body.zh: 从哥伦比亚抵达悉尼后，塞缪尔·祖卢阿加 (Samuel Zuluaga) 很幸运地找到了愿意担保他临时工作签证的雇主。 虽然这位 23 岁的年轻人希望理发店的工作能帮助他建立一个稳定的未来，但他的工资过低，错过了退休金支付，并且害怕说出自己的想法，因为他的签证取决于他是否留在雇主那里。 “大约一年后，我注意到我的雇主停止支付我的退休金，”祖卢阿加告诉 SBS 新闻。 “当时，我并不完全明白这意味着什么。我告诉自己这可能是一个错误。” 祖卢阿加表示，他不愿提出担忧，因为他担心自己在澳大利亚的工作权利受到损害。 “有一天，当我被要求打扫厕所时，我抱怨了，因为我知道这不是我的责任，”他说。 “我的雇主只是说，‘你被解雇了，收拾好东西回家吧’。就这样，我失去了工作和签证担保人。” 祖卢阿加还声称，他被拒绝支付未使用年假的工资，因为他太害怕请假了。 最终，在工会和宣传服务的支持下，他收回了欠他的钱。 “这不仅仅是钱的问题。它改变了我的处境，让我知道我并不孤单。” 祖卢阿加的经历反映了移民司法研究所最近的一份报告中提出的更广泛的担忧，该报告发现，接受调查的临时签证持有者中近三分之二的人都经历过工资不足的情况。 该报告还估计，仅国际学生每周的工资损失就超过 6000 万美元。 超过三分之一的受访者表示，他们在澳大利亚商业号码 (ABN) 或承包商安排下工作。 此前的报告指出，英语水平有限、工作场所权利意识淡薄以及难以获得支持服务是增加剥削风险的因素。 新南威尔士州工会主席马克·莫雷表示，尽管存在这种虐待，移民工人在澳大利亚经济中发挥着关键作用。 “我们知道，在农业社区、零售业、酒店业和建筑业，我们都缺乏熟练劳动力和进入经济领域的工人。” 新南威尔士州政府现已推出该州第一个专门的移民工人中心，为遭受工作场所剥削、不安全条件和工资过低的临时签证持有者提供支持。 该中心将为全州的弱势移民工人提供工作场所、安全和移民支持。 该中心将在四年内获得 650 万美元的资金支持，预计每年将通过文化敏感和基于社区的服务为约 2,000 名高危工人提供支持。 虽然它的总部位于悉尼中央商务区，但它还计划为地区社区提供额外的外展服务。 新南威尔士州州长克里斯明斯表示，这项服务将帮助工人更好地理解和执行......

reflection.en: This story draws attention to hope, endurance, and faithful rebuilding. Romans 12:12 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with steady hope and perseverance, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到盼望、忍耐与重建。Romans 12:12提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以坚定盼望与忍耐来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。
